name: Mechanical Wonder (Gyrocopter)

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/10771765-mechanical-wonder. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0. Reference-only properties require manual adjudication.

summary: Reference-only: activate with 1 minute of winding its unique hand key, taking the Utilize action each turn.
text: Reference-only: activate with 1 minute of winding its unique hand key, taking the Utilize action each turn. Operates for 8 hours. Huge vehicle weighing 500 pounds: AC 14, HP 50, Speed 5 feet, Fly 20 feet. Requires one pilot and carries up to 2,000 pounds; exceeding capacity deactivates it. Eight spectral safety cords attach or detach with a Utilize action. Attached riders glide 5 feet horizontally per foot descended. A cord stretched beyond 500 feet disappears and returns to the vehicle.
